item_short_desc: Discover the ultimate travel companion with Rothco's Canvas Double-Ender Sports Bag. Designed for versatility and durability, this spacious shoulder bag measures 30 inches x 13 inches, making it ideal for long trips and carrying sports equipment. Crafted from heavyweight canvas material, the sports bag withstands the rigors of travel and outdoor activities, ensuring long-lasting performance. The travel bag features a convenient 6.5 inch extension end pocket with a 5.5 inch internal pocket, providing ample space for storing essentials.
